segments.name: Princess Polly
segments.evidence: Princess Polly is a leading fashion brand loved globally for its trend-driven designs, viral online presence and exclusive influencer collaborations.

segments.name: Petal & Pup
segments.evidence: Petal & Pup, founded in Australia in 2014 and expanded into the U.S. via its acquisition by a.k.a. Brands in 2019, is a rapidly growing global feminine lifestyle brand, targeting women in their 20s and 30s.

segments.name: Culture Kings
segments.description: Premier streetwear retail destination offering curated in-house and third-party brands through experiential concept stores and online.
segments.evidence: Culture Kings is a premier international streetwear retail destination, standing at the intersection of fashion, art, sports and music, and a leader in the worldwide streetwear phenomenon.

segments.name: mnml
segments.description: Men's streetwear brand designing premier, fashion-forward apparel at accessible prices through direct-to-consumer and wholesale channels.
segments.evidence: mnml is a men's streetwear brand that designs premier, fashion-forward apparel at accessible prices.

revenueModel.text: Customers purchase fashion apparel, footwear and accessories through direct-to-consumer online channels, physical retail stores and wholesale partnerships with retailers.
revenueModel.evidence: Through these brands we reach a broad audience of next-generation consumers who seek fashion inspiration on social media and primarily shop online.

changes.text: Petal & Pup and Princess Polly successfully launched in Nordstrom stores in 2025, expanding brand footprint.
changes.evidence: In 2025, Petal & Pup and Princess Polly successfully launched in all Nordstrom stores across the U.S., further expanding the brands' footprint and customer touchpoints.
